videos.caption: 🌼 Aquí tienes una receta deliciosa y fácil de tarta de piña sin horno, perfecta para  cuando no quieres encender el horno. --- 🍍 Tarta de Piña sin Horno 🕒 Tiempo total Preparación: 25 minutos Reposo en nevera: 4 horas (mínimo) 🍽️ Rinde para 8 a 10 porciones --- 🧂 Ingredientes Base: 200 g de galletas tipo María o Digestive 100 g de mantequilla derretida Relleno: 1 lata grande de piña en almíbar (aprox. 500 g) 1 sobre de gelatina de piña (o neutra si prefieres menos sabor artificial) 200 ml del jugo (almíbar) de la piña 200 ml de agua caliente 200 ml de nata para montar (crema para batir) o crema de leche 200 g de queso crema (tipo Philadelphia) 3 cucharadas de azúcar (ajusta al gusto) Decoración (opcional): Rodajas de piña y cerezas en almíbar Coco rallado o virutas de chocolate blanco --- 👩‍🍳 Preparación paso a paso 1️⃣ Prepara la base 1. Tritura las galletas hasta que queden como polvo fino. 2. Mézclalas con la mantequilla derretida hasta obtener una masa arenosa. 3. Colócala en el fondo de un molde desmontable (22–24 cm) y presiona bien con una cuchara. 4. Mete el molde al refrigerador mientras preparas el relleno. 2️⃣ Prepara la mezcla de piña 1. Drena las rodajas de piña y guarda 200 ml del almíbar. 2. Disuelve el sobre de gelatina en 200 ml de agua caliente. 3. Añade el almíbar de piña y deja que temple un poco. 3️⃣ Prepara la crema 1. En un bol, bate el queso crema con el azúcar hasta que quede suave. 2. Añade la nata (o crema de leche) y mezcla bien. 3. Agrega la gelatina disuelta (ya templada, no caliente) y mezcla hasta integrar. 4. Incorpora trocitos pequeños de piña a la mezcla. 4️⃣ Monta la tarta 1. Vierte la mezcla sobre la base de galleta. 2. Alisa la superficie y lleva a la nevera por mínimo 4 horas (idealmente toda la noche). 5️⃣ Decora 1. Cuando esté firme, decora con rodajas de piña y cerezas. 2. Si quieres, espolvorea coco rallado o virutas de chocolate blanco. --- 💡 Consejos Puedes usar gelatina neutra y añadir esencia de piña o vainilla si prefieres un sabor más natural. Para una textura más ligera, sustituye el queso crema por yogur griego natural. Si la piña es muy ácida, prueba la mezcla antes de refrigerar y ajusta el azúcar. ---

Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

Pumpkin coffee cake 🎃🍂 A fluffy moist pumpkin spice cake with a touch of brown butter layered with brown sugar streusel and a maple glaze, it’s a must for fall!  Pumpkin spice cake: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter  - 1 1/4 cup brown sugar  - 2 eggs  - 1 cup pumpkin puree  - 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt  - 1 tbsp vanilla extract  - 2 cups AP flour  - 1 tbsp pumpkin pie spice  - 1/2 tsp salt  - 1 tsp baking soda - 1 tsp baking powder  Brown sugar streusel: - 1 1/2 cup brown sugar  - 1 1/2 cup AP flour  - 1/2 cup soft unsalted butter  - 1 tbsp cinnamon  - Pinch of salt  Maple glaze: - 1 cup confectioners sugar  - 1 tbsp  maple syrup  - 1 tbsp milk or heavy cream  - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - Pinch of salt  - Place a stick of butter in a small sauce pan on medium high heat, stir continuously until you have a golden foamy butter. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.  - In a large bowl combine the cooled brown butter, brown sugar, Greek yogurt, eggs and pumpkin puree. Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

Prepare the Beef:    - Cut the steak into bite-sized pieces and remove any fat or tendons.    - Tenderize the beef by mixing it with baking soda and water. Let it sit for 10 minutes, then rinse well and pat dry. 2. Marinate the Beef:    - In a mixing bowl, combine the Chinese cooking wine, oyster sauce, egg white, cornstarch, and all-purpose flour.    - Add the beef to the marinade and give it a good massage.    - Add 1 tbsp of oil to seal in the flavors and let the beef marinate for at least 20 minutes. 3. Deep Fry or Stir Fry the Garlic and Beef:    - Heat oil in a pan and deep fry the garlic cloves at 350°F for about 1 minute, until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside. 5. Nepali Style Chicken Chukauni  🥣 Serves: 3 🔥 Macros (per serving): Calories: 374 kcal | Protein: 38 g | Carbs: 2.7 g | Fat: 22.3 g Ingredients For the Chicken 	•	400 g boneless chicken thigh (or breast), cut into small cubes 	•	2 tsp ginger-garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp pepper 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp lemon juice 	•	Light brush or spray of oil for frying For the Mix 	•	1 small onion, thinly sliced 	•	1–2 green chilies, chopped 	•	3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, chopped (divided) For the Yogurt Base 	•	1 cup thick curd (I used Amul High-Protein Curd) or Greek yogurt  	•	1 tsp garlic paste 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp sugar For the Tadka 	•	1.5 tbsp mustard oil 	•	½ tsp turmeric powder 	•	1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder 	•	1 tsp kasuri methi, crushed Method 1️⃣ Mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, salt, pepper, Kashmiri chili powder, turmeric, and lemon juice. Rest 10–15 minutes. 2️⃣ Brush or spray a pan with very little oil. Pan-fry chicken on medium-high until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl. 3️⃣ Add sliced onion, chopped chilies, and half the coriander. Mix well and set aside. 4️⃣ In another bowl, whisk thick curd with garlic paste, salt, and sugar until smooth and creamy. 5️⃣ Heat mustard oil until smoking hot. Turn off the heat, add turmeric, Kashmiri chili powder, and crushed kasuri methi. 6️⃣ Pour the hot tadka into the curd and swirl gently to keep the streaks. 7️⃣ Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture. Mix gently. Finish with more chopped coriander leaves. Enjoy with soft rotis or steaming hot rice. .
